description: 经典留白 - 黑白灰层级与克制蓝色交互感，安静现代，适合产品 / 设计 / 审美类文章

styles.body: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1d1d1f; line-height: 1.82; letter-spacing: 0.1px; padding: 18px 14px; background: #ffffff;
styles.h1: font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.32; margin: 38px 0 20px; color: #1d1d1f; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.3px;
styles.h2: font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.4; margin: 34px 0 17px; color: #1d1d1f; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.2px;
styles.blockquote: margin: 24px 0; padding: 16px 18px; color: #515154; background: #f5f5f7; border-left: 3px solid #86868b; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.8;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 12px; margin: 24px auto; display: block; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
styles.code_inline: font-family: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.91em; background: #f2f2f5; color: #1f1f22; padding: 0.1em 0.34em; border-radius: 5px;
styles.code_block: margin: 1.05em 0; padding: 1.02em; background: #1c1c1e; color: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6;
styles.li_bullet: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #86868b; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;
styles.li_number: display: inline-block; min-width: 27px; margin-right: 9px; color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; margin: 24px 0; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; table-layout: fixed; word-break: break-word;
styles.th: border-bottom: 1px solid #d2d2d7; padding: 10px 11px; background: #f5f5f7; color: #1d1d1f; text-align: left; font-weight: 650;
styles.td: border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5ea; padding: 10px 11px; color: #3a3a3c; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1.62;
styles.caption: font-size: 12.5px; color: #7a7f87; text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.section_divider: text-align: center; color: #a1a1a6; letter-spacing: 8px; font-size: 11px; margin: 38px 0; user-select: none;

list_style.label: 极简灰阶序号
list_style.num_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 27px; margin-right: 9px; color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
list_style.bullet_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #86868b; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;
